module.Title: Compare Player Health
module.Teaching: Comparison operators produce a bool. The > operator asks whether the value on the left is greater than the value on the right.
module.PredictionQuestion: What is the result type of playerHealth > 0?
module.PredictionExplanation: Comparisons answer true or false, so their result is a bool.
module.DebugPrompt: A single equals sign assigns a value. Use > to test whether health is above zero.
module.RecallPrompt: Create isAlive by checking whether playerHealth is greater than zero. Use the exact value 0.
module.TransferPrompt: Create hasStone by checking whether stoneCount is greater than zero. Use the exact value 0.
module.PreviewMessage: The game can now determine whether the player is alive.
